note: Tested-together version set for this build, not 'whatever is newest'. Each row's Windows compatibility comes from what actually built/ran in this session's CI (GitHub Actions windows-latest / ubuntu-latest), not assumption.

python.verified: py_compile + real module import of all 18 app/plugins modules under python3.13 in this session (docs/PYTHON_IMPORT_REPORT.json); NOT yet run on Windows itself for the AI extras

python_fallback.note: kept as fallback only; AI extras (ctranslate2/onnxruntime native wheels) not confirmed 3.14-compatible by anyone in this project

ffmpeg.compatible_with: yt-dlp 2026.07.04 (ffmpeg is only used as a subprocess by both app/audio_tools.py and yt-dlp, no ABI coupling)

go_toolchain.verified: all 4 windows_build binaries (launcher/setup/progress/uninstaller) built and ran assembleDebug-equivalent self-test successfully in windows-build.yml CI, run 9 (commit 99c3387)

webview2.loader_strategy: github.com/jchv/go-webview2 looks for WebView2Loader.dll next to the exe first, falls back to an in-memory copy embedded in the binary itself -- physical Fixed Version Runtime folder staging (Program/runtime/webview2/) is NOT yet wired into windows-build.yml's packaging step, tracked in docs/GAP_ANALYSIS.md

android.kotlin_compose_plugin: 2.1.0 (org.jetbrains.kotlin.plugin.compose -- required separately since Kotlin 2.0, confirmed by a real CI failure this session before it was added)
android.verified: ./gradlew assembleDebug + testDebugUnitTest + lintDebug all passed on ubuntu-latest with android-actions/setup-android in this session (android-build.yml run 9, commit 99c3387) -- this exact version combination is what actually built, not a theoretical pick

known_incompatibilities_avoided: Kotlin 2.1.0 + old-style android.composeOptions.kotlinCompilerExtensionVersion: fails outright since Kotlin 2.0 (real CI failure hit and fixed this session, see git history commit 4ce9c9e)

Python 3.14 (not 3.13) as the primary embeddable target: no evidence in this project that ctranslate2/onnxruntime wheels support 3.14 yet; 3.13 is what the original shipped .pyc cache and this session's real import test both confirm works
